sources.content: # CLAUDE.md for Thrummet. Thrummet is a notification delivery service written in TypeScript on Node.js 20. It sends email through a provider adapter in `src/channels/email/`, SMS through `src/channels/sms/`, and mobile push through `src/channels/push/`. Start a local copy with `npm run dev`, which listens on port 4310. Jobs are queued in Redis 7; set `REDIS_URL` in `.env.local`. Run `npm test` for unit tests and `npm run test:e2e` for end-to-end tests. Configuration defaults live in `config/default.json`.

Rules. Never log a recipient's phone number or email address in full; use the `maskRecipient()` helper in `src/lib/mask.ts`. Retries use exponential backoff with at most 5 attempts per message, then the message moves to the dead-letter queue. Templates live in `templates/` as Handlebars files, one folder per locale. A new channel needs an adapter that implements the `Channel` interface in `src/channels/types.ts`. Do not edit `src/generated/`; run `npm run codegen` instead.

claims.text: Thrummet retries each message up to 10 times.
A new Thrummet channel needs an adapter that implements the Channel interface.
The Thrummet local dev server listens on port 3000.
Thrummet code must not log a recipient's full email address.
